scope: MQTT sensor callback and compatibility ClickHouse fallback error containment

behavior.callback_logs: Legacy and QoS 1 callback logs include only the exception class, not broker, payload, or database details.
behavior.qos1_retry: QoS 1 processing failures raise a bounded error without acknowledging the message so broker redelivery remains available.
behavior.clickhouse_fallback: The direct compatibility fallback logs only the ClickHouse exception class.
behavior.tls_startup: Certificate/key configuration failures log and raise only the bounded exception class; startup remains fail-closed.

coverage: legacy callback log excludes secret-bearing exception text
QoS 1 callback propagates a bounded error and does not acknowledge a failed delivery
ClickHouse compatibility fallback log excludes secret-bearing endpoint details
TLS startup error and log exclude secret-bearing certificate paths and details

static_checks.database_or_broker_access: none; mocked callback, process-delivery, and projection boundaries

limitations: No MQTT broker, ClickHouse endpoint, or database was contacted.
This does not establish live QoS redelivery, consumer availability, or MAN-CAP acceptance.
